shortDescription: Indian listed companies are stepping up equity offerings to institutional investors as ample liquidity and improving sentiment open a faster route to raise funds, according to Bloomberg.The article says the share-sale pipeline has widened as firms move to tap the market.

title: India Share Sale Pipeline Grows as Companies Seek Funding
